name: interaction-design-board
description: >- Generates several distinct, clickable HTML interaction prototypes for one product surface into a Design Board and collects selection/remix feedback before implementation. Use for multiple UI versions, interaction alternatives, progressive-disclosure options, or when styling is fine but hierarchy/workflow/interaction feels off. Not for static visual-style calibration (use design-style-picker) or a settled CSS tweak.
author: daymade
